description: Records one call outcome on a recruiting candidate (candidate_id, from read the candidate), as the one-tap outcome buttons do: outcome one of no_answer, left_message, not_a_fit, promising. It logs the attempt, advances the candidate's stage and schedules the next call. not_a_fit requires reject_reason. Nothing is sent. Revert it with revert_candidate_outcome. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat of the same key changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_candidate_outcome
title: Record a recruiting call outcome
